Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Boxwood SIG questionnaire + intake logistics

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Boxwood is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the private deployment options. We're kicking off the SIG intake for our procurement cycle and I attached our master questionnaire (see attachment).

High-level asks from us:
- Completed SIG questionnaire (tab-delimited where possible)
- Control mapping to your SOC 2 / ISO artifacts (CSV or similar)
- Evidence artifacts or links (reports, screenshots, config exports)
- Proposed timeline for any gaps we flag

Can you confirm who on your side will own the control responses and where we should upload evidence? Our intake portal will accept files and links; alternatively we can provide a temporary SFTP if you prefer.

We'd like an initial pass back in 72 hours if feasible, and a full packet within 10 business days.

Cheers,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Boxwood Financial

Attachment: Boxwood_SIG_Questions_2028.xlsx (xlsx, 74 rows)

Elena — thanks for the questionnaire and for outlining the timeline. We can meet the 72-hour initial pass target.

Quick plan:
- I'll be the point of contact for the intake and will coordinate evidence collection (kimberly.park@redwood.ai).
- Karthik (security engineering) will lead the control mappings and SOC 2 tie-outs.
- Marissa (assurance) will package artifacts and confirm attestations.

Preferred intake flow: please upload the questionnaire and any large artifacts to the shared Drive link below; smaller files can be attached in email. We will populate the questionnaire (Tab: Responses) and provide a control mapping CSV that references the artifact filenames. Where there are gaps, we'll call them out and provide a remediation/mitigation note plus ETA.

Deliverables for the 72-hour pass (by Fri EOD, Sep 15 Pacific):
- Partial-complete questionnaire with answers for straightforward controls
- control-mapping-draft.csv with initial artifact references
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf (redacted as needed)

If Boxwood needs encrypted transfer, we can also push to your SFTP. Which do you prefer?

Link for upload: https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/Boxwood/SIG-Intake

Thanks — I'll loop Karthik and Marissa to stand up owners.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations

Kimberly / Marissa — I'm on it. Initial notes after skimming the questionnaire:

- Many questions map directly to controls in our SOC 2 Type II scope (AuthN, Privileged Access, Change Mgmt, Logging, Incident Response). I'll prepare a mapping file with the following columns: Boxwood_Q_ID, Redwood_Control_ID, Evidence_File, Notes, Status.
- For ISO 27001 items, we'll reference our ISMS documentation and the same set of audit evidence.
- A few items request live configuration (e.g., KMS key rotation audit logs). For those we'll provide redacted screenshots and exported logs (time-windowed) and call out the retention window.

Attachments I'll prepare in the first pass (deliver by Fri EOD):
1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf (redacted)
2) control-mapping-draft.csv (initial mappings)
3) summary-ask-list.txt (where we'll need Boxwood clarification or Okta org-level details)

Two quick asks for Boxwood:
- For vendor-specific cryptography controls, do you require HSM attestation or is KMS with rotation policy sufficient?
- Are you collecting evidence per control or per requirement? I'll shape the mapping to whichever you prefer; per-control is usually easier for us.

Ben / Jasmine — please confirm artifact access and redaction guardrails. Marissa, can you own packaging to the Drive folder and prepare a short README that explains filenames and redaction?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf (pdf, 52 pages), control-mapping-draft.csv (csv, 124 rows), summary-ask-list.txt (txt)

Packaging notes:
- I redacted customer-specific logs and PII from the exported screenshots per our redaction checklist. The README at the Drive root explains what was redacted and why.

- We flagged three Boxwood questions as "clarify" in summary-ask-list.txt: key management, cross-region backup access controls, and retention policy for telemetry.

Timeline update: initial pass uploaded to Drive (https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/Boxwood/SIG-Intake) and Boxwood notified. Plan for full packet (after Boxwood clarifications) by Sep 25.

Kimberly / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the Drive upload. Confirming receipt and that the first pass looks complete for our internal review. A couple items from our side:

- We prefer per-control evidence references (helps our tooling ingest the CSV).
- For KMS rotation, HSM attestation is not required at this stage — rotation policy + console exports are fine.
- We'll upload any additional compliance context for Boxwood in the next 48 hours (procurement will add contract-level requirements).

Next steps: Boxwood security will run automated ingestion overnight and triage the clarifications. If any of the flagged items require deeper access (e.g., ephemeral logs), we'll coordinate a scoped session.

Appreciate the clear README and the redaction notes — that made review much faster.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Boxwood Financial
